translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
qasam hai sitaray ki jab woh giray ,
. ( aey makkay kay bashindo ! ) yeh tumharay sath rehney walay sahab naa raasta bhoolay hain , naa bhatkay hain ,
aur yeh apni khuwaish say kuch nahi boltay ,
yeh to khalis wahi hai jo inn kay paas bheji jati hai ,
enhen aik aesay mazboot taqat walay ( farishtay ) ney taleem di hai
jo quooat ka hamil hai .   chunacheh woh samney aagaya ,
jabkay woh buland ufaq per tha .
phir woh qareeb aaya , aur jhuk parra ,
yahan tak kay woh do kamanon  kay faslay kay barabar qareeb aagaya ,   balkay uss say bhi ziyada nazdeek .
iss tarah Allah ko apney banday per jo wahi nazil farmani thi , woh nazil farmaee .
jo kuch unhon ney dekha , dil ney uss mein koi ghalati nahi ki .
kiya phir bhi tum unn say uss cheez kay baaray mein jhagarrtay ho jissay woh dekhtay hain-?
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay unhon ney uss ( farishtay ) ko aik aur martaba dekha hai ,
uss bair kay darkht kay paas jiss ka naam sidra-tul-muntaha hai ,
ussi kay paas jannat-ul-Maawa hai .
uss waqt uss bair kay darkht per woh cheezen chai hoi then jo bhi uss per chai hoi then .
. ( payghumber ki ) aankh naa to chakrai , aur naa hadd say aagay barhi .
sach to yeh hai kay unhon ney apney perwerdigar ki bari bari nishaniyon mein say boht kuch dekha .
bhala kiya tum ney laat aur uzza ( ki haqeeqat ) per bhi ghor kiya hai-?
aur uss aik aur teesray per jiss ka naam manaat hai-?
kiya tumharay liye to betay hon , aur Allah kay liye betiyan-?
phir to yeh bari bhondi taqseem hoi !

unn ki haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi hai kay yeh kuch naam hain jo tum ney aur tumharay baap dadon ney rakh liye hain , Allah ney unn kay haq mein koi saboot nazil nahi kiya . dar-haqeeqat yeh ( kafir ) log mehaz weham o gumaan aur nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay chal rahey hain , halankay inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say inn kay paas hidayat aa-chuki hai .
kiya insan ko her uss cheez ka haq phonchta hai jiss ki woh tamanna keray-?
. ( nahi ! ) kiyonkay aakhirat aur duniya to tamam tarr Allah hi kay ikhtiyar mein hain .

aur aasmano mein kitney hi farishtay hain jinn ki sifarish kissi kay kuch bhi kaam nahi aa-sakti , albatta iss kay baad hi kaam aa-sakti hai kay Allah jiss kay liye chahye ijazat deydey , aur uss per razi hojaye .
jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh farishton ko zananey naamon say yaad kertay hain ,
halankay unhen iss baat ka zara bhi ilm nahi hai . woh mehaz weham o gumaan kay peechay chal rahey hain , aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay weham o gumaan haq kay moamlay mein bilkul kaar aamad nahi .
lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum aesay aadmi ki fiker naa kero jiss ney humari naseehat hidayat say mun morr liya hai , aur dunyawi zindagi kay siwa woh kuch aur chahta hi nahi .
aesay logon  kay ilm ki phonch bus yahin tak hai .   tumhara perwerdigar hi khoob janta hai kay kon uss kay raastay say bhatak chuka hai , aur wohi khoob janta hai kon raah paagaya hai .

aur aasmano mein jo kuch hai , woh bhi aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , woh bhi Allah hi ka hai . nateeja yeh hai kay jinhon ney buray kaam kiye hain , woh unn ko unn kay amal ka bhi badla dey ga , aur jinhon ney naik kaam kiye hain , unn ko behtareen badla ata keray ga .

unn logon  ko jo baray baray gunahon aur bey hayai kay kamon say bachtay hain , albatta kabhi kabhar phisal janey ki baat aur hai .   yaqeen rakho tumhara perwerdigar boht wasee maghfirat wala hai , woh tumhen khoob janta hai jab uss ney tumhen zameen say peda kiya , aur jab tum apni maon kay pet mein bacchay thay , lehaza tum apney aap ko pakeezah naa thehrao . woh khoob janta hai kay kon muttaqi hai .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) bhala tum ney uss shaks ko bhi dekha jo ( haq say ) mun morr gaya ,
aur jiss ney thora saa diya , phir ruk gaya-?
kiya uss kay paas ghaib ka ilm hai jo woh dekh raha ho-?
kiya ussay unn baaton ki khabar nahi mili jo musa kay saheefon mein darj hai ,
aur Ibrahim kay saheefon mein bhi , jo mukammal wafadaar rahey-?
yani yeh kay koi bojh uthaney wala kissi doosray ( kay gunah ) ka bojh nahi utha sakta ,
aur yeh kay insan ko khud apni koshish kay siwa kissi aur cheez ka ( badla lenay ka ) haq nahi phonchta ,
aur yeh kay uss ki koshish unqareeb dekhi jaye gi ,
phir uss ka badla ussay poora poora diya jaye ga .
aur yeh kay aakhir kaar ( sabb ko ) tumharay perwerdigar hi kay paas phonchna hai ,
aur yeh kay wohi hai jo hansata aur rulata hai ,
aur yeh kay wohi hai jo moat bhi deta hai , aur zindagi bhi ,
aur yeh kay ussi ney nar aur mada kay do jooray peda kiye hain
. ( woh bhi sirf ) aik boond say jab woh tapkai jati hai ,
aur yeh kay doosri zindagi denay ka bhi ussi ney zimma liya hai ,
aur yeh kay wohi hai jo maal daar banata aur dolat ko mehfooz kerata hai ,
aur yeh kay wohi hai jo sheyree sitaray ka perwerdigar hai ,
aur yeh kay wohi hai jiss ney pichlay zamaney ki qoam-e-aad ko halak kiya ,
aur samood ko bhi , aur kissi ko baqi naa chorra ,
aur iss say pehlay nooh ki qoam ko bhi ( halak kiya ) . beyshak woh sabb say ziyada zalim aur sarkash thay .
aur jo bastiyan ondhi giri then ,   unn ko bhi ussi ney utha phenka tha ,
phir jiss ( khofnak ) cheez ney unhen dhaanpa , woh unhen dhaanp ker hi rahi .
lehaza ( aey insan ! ) tu apney perwerdigar ki kon konsi naimaton mein shak keray ga-?
yeh ( payghumber ) bhi pehlay khabrdar kernay walay payghumberon ki tarah aik khabrdar kernay walay hain .
jo gharri jald aaney wali hai , woh qareeb aa-phonchi hai ,
Allah kay siwa koi nahi hai jo ussay hata sakay .
to kiya tum issi baat per hayrat kertay ho-?
aur ( uss ka mazaq bana ker ) hanstay ho , aur rotay nahi ho ,
jabkay tum takabbur kay sath khel kood mein parray huye ho-?
abb ( bhi ) jhuk jao Allah kay samney , aur uss ki bandagi kerlo .
